jobs.description:
SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging UIs.

• Ability to follow - and build on - an established art direction

• Some experience creating wireframes, user flows and mockups - we don’t expect you to be a UX expert, but we expect you to be the UI expert, and have a solid grasp of how that fits into UX.

• Skilled at designing, rendering - and possibly animating - high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity or similar engines, and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job Description

Do you have solid experience leading large-scale IT projects? Are you motivated by delivering innovative IT solutions to complex, society-critical challenges? If so, you may be our next colleague in the role of IT Manager at Netcompany. As a Manager, you will be challenged in a position that requires strong leadership capabilities as well as technical expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

As an IT Manager, you will be responsible for leading large-scale IT projects from initiation through successful delivery. You will manage project teams, oversee project risks, and ensure high standards of quality, delivery, and stakeholder satisfaction. In addition, you will play a key role in client advisory services, business development activities, and proposal management.

Beyond your leadership responsibilities, you will be expected to contribute with strong technical expertise. You will act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on technical solution design and implementation, helping project teams and clients solve complex challenges.

Alongside your project management responsibilities, you will serve as a mentor to consultants and senior consultants. This long-term mentoring relationship will give you the opportunity to support, guide, and contribute to the professional development of your mentees throughout their careers at Netcompany.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Leading projects and ensuring successful delivery and progress, typically based on agile development methodologies.

• Participating in steering committee meetings with senior representatives from both Netcompany and the client organization.

• Advising the client on project deliverables.

• Coordinating activities across multiple project workstreams, including testing, organizational implementation, and software development.

• Leading proposal teams and conducting development and performance discussions with your mentees.

About you

We expect you to hold a masters's degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you have:

• 
Strong technical expertise and relevant experience within the IT industry.

• 
Proven experience leading large and complex IT delivery projects, including projects utilizing agile development methodologies.

• 
Strong commercial awareness combined with the ability to build trust and lead high-performing teams.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

**The Role

**We are looking for an engineer passionate about building the next generation of high-scale audio processing infrastructure for communication centers that form a vital part of our critical infrastructure, including emergency dispatch centers and hospitals. You will be responsible for integrating AI capabilities into environments dominated by network protocols like SIP and SIPREC, ensuring robust and scalable performance at the heart of life-critical operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Architect and maintain systems processing over 100,000 calls per day.

• Develop foundational infrastructure using network protocols such as SIP and SIPREC.

• Integrate AI capabilities into low-latency, high-throughput audio processing pipelines.

• Collaborate with the Platform Engineering team with a commitment to engineering excellence to ensure system reliability and scalability.

• Hands-on development of an innovative solution where design choices matter

• Work with colleagues in design and code reviews

• Contribute to a strong culture of development at Corti through mentorship of developers of all levels

**What You Bring

**

• Master of Golang

• Deep understanding of network protocols, specifically SIP and SIPREC

• Proven track record of building and scaling foundational infrastructure

• Experience in ideating and implementing features with high complexity

• Hands-on experience with cloud computing architecture and development

• Experience running, monitoring, and operating REST, WebSockets, Kafka or an event-driven architecture

• Experience with containers and orchestration tools

• A passion for writing clean and efficient code

• Experience with WebSocket, gRPC and CockroachDB is a significant plus.

• Experience with real-time audio processing and WebRTC is a significant plus.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication

**Life at Corti

**

• You will be reporting to the Director of Platform Engineering.

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• Hybrid working environment in Copenhagen.

• Equipment provided by Corti

**Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

**_🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status._At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

Intro

Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories, including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal, and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

What's in it for you?

This is a high-impact commercial role where you will take real ownership of key pharmacy partnerships, influence how our brands win in-store, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and external partners. You'll join a fast-moving international business where ideas turn into action quickly and where there is plenty of room to shape the role, grow your commercial expertise and make a visible impact.

What you'll be doing

• Develop and execute customer strategies for key pharmacy accounts together with the Sales Director, Brand Managers and E-commerce KAM

• Plan, submit, execute and evaluate trade campaigns together with internal teams and external agencies.

• Build, strengthen and grow strategic relationships with existing pharmacy partners

• Lead annual customer planning, commercial negotiations and account development

• Identify commercial opportunities that drive sustainable growth, profitability and sell-out performance

• Ensure customer campaigns, pricing, assortment, product information and commercial activities are implemented accurately and on time

• Act as a commercial sparring partner to Brand Managers to create best-in-class brand visibility and in-store execution

• Manage key wholesaler processes, including maintenance of pricing, assortment and customer information

• Take ownership of the CRM system supporting pharmacy sales representatives and help ensure effective commercial execution of key pharmacy accounts

• Use customer, market and commercial insights to continuously improve performance, service levels and ways of working

Requirements

• Master's degree, professional bachelor's degree or equivalent education in a relevant field

• Solid experience from a commercial, sales or key account management environment

• Being structured and managing customer processes diligently and promptly

• Experience working with B2C customers, ideally within FMCG, consumer healthcare, pharmaceuticals, retail or another fast-moving industry

• Experience with the Danish pharmacy market or consumer healthcare sector is an advantage

• Strong commercial mindset with experience in customer negotiations, account planning and business development

• Excellent relationship management and stakeholder management skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset with a strong "go-do" attitude

• Comfortable taking ownership, working independently and building structure in a dynamic environment

• Commercially and financially minded, with the ability to balance customer opportunities with profitable growth

• Able to maintain a strong overview while managing multiple priorities in a changing international business

Benefits

• Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage

• Apart from a competitive salary pack, there are lots of growth opportunities to meet your personal ambitions

• Flexible schedule and life work balance

• Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects that have a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry

• Very positive work environment in a young, international, and motivated team

• Start-up spirit while being a part of the large international organization with strong values

Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

The short version

A venture-backed Danish medical imaging company is hiring its first dedicated AI/ML scientist. The company has a CE-marked product already in clinical use and is now building the next generation of diagnostic tools on top of the imaging data that product generates.

This is not a role where you inherit a dataset and a backlog. The data largely does not exist yet. Part of this job is going out to hospitals, working alongside clinicians, and finding out whether the data they hold actually contains the answer to the question they are asking. The other part is turning that into methods and working prototypes.

If you want a clean pipeline and a defined problem, this is the wrong role. If you want to define the problem, it is close to ideal.

The company

Venture-backed, Danish, around 40 people, with offices in Copenhagen. The technology is PET-based functional imaging that produces quantitative measurements rather than pictures alone — the ability to put a number on physiological function, not just describe what an image looks like.

The first product is CE-marked and in clinical use, with a pivotal trial running and a regulatory submission planned in the United States. Quantification is the core of the company’s value: it is what competitors do not offer, and it is the thing this role is hired to extend.

The company is named at first conversation. We have not put it in writing here.

The mission

The imaging data is the future product line. Today the company measures blood flow in the heart. The question is what else the same data can answer – in cardiology, in neurology, and beyond – and what methods are needed to get there.

You are hired to answer that. You will be the company’s dedicated AI/ML voice, joining a software team of eight and reporting to the Head of Software. You will work across R&D, clinical development, quality and regulatory.

Concretely, the first twelve months look like this:

• Building working relationships with clinicians and technicians at partner hospitals, in Denmark and nearby

• Getting into clinics and understanding how the scans are actually acquired and read

• Identifying which data holds real signal — and being honest when it does not

• Running studies and projects alongside hospital doctors

• Building prototypes that show whether a method works

Success at six months is measured in relationships and prototypes, not in shipped features.

What you will actually do

• Invent, prototype and mature algorithms for extracting clinically meaningful information from PET data

• Translate clinical and scientific questions into testable algorithmic solutions

• Build the pipelines around the work — acquisition, quality control, processing, visualisation, presentation of findings

• Go to hospitals. Observe workflows. Ask clinicians what they need and validate that your assumptions survive contact with clinical reality

• Evaluate emerging methods and tools, and shape which directions the company invests in

• Support the AI/ML dimension of medical device compliance as methods mature toward product — CE-marking and FDA

Travel is roughly two to three days per month, primarily within Denmark and southern Sweden.

Who we are looking for

Essential

• Demonstrable AI/ML development experience — applied, and with something you can point to and say “I built that”

• A software engineering and algorithm background, hands-on with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX or Keras, and disciplined about testing and version control

• Experience with data collection, selection, integration and quality control, and preparing datasets for training

• Comfort starting from a rough idea rather than a specification

• Someone who wants to be in the room with clinicians. This role does not work from a desk — you need to be willing to initiate conversations with doctors and technicians, ask uncomfortable questions, and keep asking

• Roughly three to eight years of relevant experience. A PhD, or a PhD plus postdoc, counts — provided the work was applied and you have built things

Strongly preferred

• Medical imaging: DICOM, and work on 3D or 4D volumetric data — segmentation, registration, classification or quantification. PET, MR or X-ray all count

• PET-specific knowledge — reconstruction, attenuation and scatter correction, tracer kinetics, quantification. Genuinely valuable, genuinely not required on day one. The company expects to teach this

• Medical device software or SaMD experience — IEC 62304, quality systems, verification and validation, CE-marking or FDA

• A background in healthcare, medtech, diagnostics or another regulated field

Education

Computer science, biomedical engineering, medical physics or similar is typical. Proven capability substitutes for credentials.

Relocation

Candidates relocating to Denmark will be considered.

What this is, honestly

The genuine appeal. This is the company’s first and only AI/ML hire. Nobody has done this before you, there is no established way of working to inherit, and the direction the company takes on AI is the direction you argue for. It is an unusual amount of ownership for someone at this level, and it is the main reason to take the role.

What you should weigh. You will be the only AI/ML person among eight developers. There is no in-house peer to review your methods and no senior imaging-AI person to learn from — the clinical and scientific expertise sits with the company’s hospital collaborators and advisors rather than inside the building. Some people find that liberating. Others find it isolating, and it is worth being honest with yourself about which you are before you apply.

The other thing to weigh is the data. It is early. Expect to spend real time on access, agreements, site visits and data quality before you spend it on model architecture.

Interested, or want to know more?

Black Swans Exist is running this search exclusively. We will tell you who the company is at first conversation, and we will tell you the parts that are not in this document.

If it is not right for you but you know who it is right for, we would genuinely like to hear from you.

Are you passionate about clinical research and eager to make a significant impact in the world of drug development? NBCD is seeking a dedicated Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to join our dynamic team at the forefront of international drug development research. Join us in an environment fueled by dedication and inspired by our core values: "Team up, Take on, and Try out." Here, you'll have the chance to make a significant difference while expanding your skillset.

Who are we?

NBCD, a key part of the Sanos Group with around 245 employees, is a world-leading CRO specializing in osteoarthritis and musculoskeletal diseases. We provide top-tier scientific and clinical trial services to the biotech and pharmaceutical industries. At NBCD, innovation is at our core, enabling us to develop life-changing medications efficiently through pioneering study designs and flawless execution. We focus on a few therapeutic areas, letting science drive our business, particularly in connective tissue diseases like osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. Our comprehensive support covers everything from study design to regulatory affairs, ensuring expert handling at every step. Renowned worldwide for our scientific and operational excellence, NBCD leads in international medication development.

Your key role and responsibilities

Your role will be highly varied and include the following responsibilities:

• You will conduct on-site monitoring of NBCD trials according to ICH-GCP, which involves regular visits to hospitals and clinics in Denmark and other countries to:

• Ensure patient rights and safety are protected, and that physicians conduct trials according to protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and approved procedures.

• Verify that electronically reported data is accurate, complete, and matches source data in patient files.

• Educate site staff and provide guidance on study-related matters.

• Write visit reports and follow-up letters to investigators.

NBCD has pioneered Risk-Based Monitoring, and you will play a critical role in Centralized Monitoring, a major part of this process. This includes:

• Remotely reviewing clinical database entries at our Søborg office to ensure data quality by proactively identifying issues, analyzing trends, and querying investigators for appropriate actions.

• Documenting findings and actions in centralized monitoring reports.

• Ensuring the Centralized Monitoring approach effectively identifies issues remotely.

Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our Clinical Trial Managers (CTM), assist them and gain responsibility for various tasks related to study or vendor management. These tasks can be tailored to your skills and interests.

Desired skills and experience

We are looking for candidates with an educational degree in health sciences who have experience with good clinical practice and clinical trials, whether through university projects or previous positions. Excellent communication skills are essential, and since most of our communication is in English, fluency in business English, both oral and written, is required.

Additionally, as the role involves on-site monitoring at Danish investigational sites, we prefer candidates who speak Danish natively or fluently.

Personal profile

You excel at working independently and take full accountability for your responsibilities. With a keen eye for detail, you understand that study monitoring relies on the accurate and thorough review of patient files and supporting documents. You are dedicated to meeting deadlines and following through on commitments, working persistently and with self-motivation.

You are committed to fostering a positive work environment where colleagues can thrive. You approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, maintaining a positive and optimistic outlook that encourages collaboration and respects individualism.

You are comfortable with broad responsibilities, as we value agility and efficiency, and believe in empowering our employees with the freedom to operate and innovate. Your enthusiasm for innovative research drives your desire to learn new approaches and expand your core skill set.

Additionally, you are willing and able to travel both within Denmark and internationally, as our CRAs also monitor sites in English-speaking countries such as the UK and USA.

Are we the right cultural fit for you?

Our commitment to you is encapsulated in our promise to every one of our employees saying ‘Trust in you - in your development and impact´.

This pledge extends uniformly across all entities within the Sanos Group organization, including NBCD, ensuring that you feel its effects from the very offset of your interaction.

If you are curious about whether you would thrive within the Sanos Group culture and the Sanos Way of Leading, reflect on whether you see yourself working within our principles:

• Take on - Responsibility is given, and we inspire you to take it.

• Try out - Explore diverse tasks and grow professionally.

• Team up - We don’t just work together; we thrive together.

Want to know more? Check out the Voice of NBCD people here.

Apply and make a real impact

We look forward to hearing from you, so please send your application through the “apply” link.

We will be performing interviews ongoing in the process and look to fill the position as soon as possible. We close the position when we find the right candidate.

For further information about the role please contact, Associate Director, Anne Andresen, anne@nbcd.com.

You will be office-based at our headquarters in Søborg and you will be required to travel on a regular basis to our clinical sites within Denmark and other countries.

If you proceed in the recruitment process, you will go through a few additional steps where both you and we will assess whether this position is the right match for both parties. As part of the recruitment process, we use assessments to ensure the optimal match and the best foundation for future collaboration.

NBCD is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives leads to better decision-making and innovation. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

We value your data and take care to protect it. Please see more information regarding privacy for job applicants here: https://nbcd.career.emply.com/privacy-policy

Why this role

We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes.

This role has two sides. With clients, you’ll be the data architect they rely on: setting up data governance, running the design authority and making the calls that keep their data landscape coherent. Inside BASE, you’ll help lead our Commercial data team by developing people, shaping proposals and helping us win new work. We don’t expect you to be equally strong on both sides, and we’ll shape the role around where you bring the most.

What you’ll do

With clients:

• Act as lead data architect on MDM and data platform programmes for life sciences clients

• Set up and run data governance, including ownership, standards and decision rights

• Chair design authority meetings and make the architecture calls across MDM, data platform and CRM integration

• Work with client stakeholders, from business owners to IT leadership

Inside BASE:

• Manage and develop consultants in our data team

• Lead or contribute to RFP responses and solution proposals

• Present in client orals and pre-sales meetings

• Share knowledge and help grow our data practice

What you bring

• A proven track record in a leading role on MDM or data platform implementations, deep in one and credible across both:

• MDM (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM)

• data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC)

• Hands-on experience with data governance and with running a design authority or similar architecture forum

• Experience managing and developing people

• Pre-sales experience, such as RFP responses, proposals or orals

• A good understanding of delivery methodologies such as Agile, waterfall and hybrid

• A general understanding of customer engagement (CE) processes such as CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management

• Confident communication, spoken and written, with both business and technical audiences

• Excellent English

A plus if you have

• Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes

• A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica)

• Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData

• GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

(Senior) Consultant - OCM

Devote Consulting • Full-time • København, DK • 1m ago

**SENIOR CONSULTANT - OCM

******Join Our Team at Devote Consulting

****Are you an experienced professional from the pharmaceutical industry, passionate about improving business processes and driving impactful change? Devote Consulting is expanding its team and is looking for a Senior Consultant with expertise in organizational change management (OCM) in the life science industry.

****Are We Looking for You?

• You thrive in the fast-paced life of consulting and enjoy sharing your knowledge and ideas

• You take ownership of your tasks, delivering high-quality work that makes a difference for people

• You have experience working with optimization of business processes and rolling out change to maximize benefits and user adoption

• You are excited about improving processes and implementing systems in Life Science R&D

• You’ll excel in our high-achieving culture, with ample opportunities for both personal and professional growth.

****What You’ll Do

****As a Senior Consultant at Devote Consulting with an OCM speciality, your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting projects: Deliver changes in the life sciences industry focused on processes, data, and systems within R&D, clinical operations, and regulatory affairs.

• Business process optimization: (Re)design and improve business workflows for greater efficiency.

• Stakeholder management: Lead planning, change management, and foster inclusion and stakeholder management on all levels

• Driving project success: Ensure project progress and maintain high-quality standards for communication material and OCM strategies

**Your Qualifications

**We’re looking for individuals with the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree in business administration, IT, life sciences or equivalent

• 5+ years of experience as a consultant, business analyst, project manager, change lead or equivalent role in regulated industries such as Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech

• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for making an impact

• Experience in creating OCM strategies, as well as the execution incl. stakeholder management, training and communication material

• Fluent in English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Expertise in Clinical R&D systems (CTMS, eTMF, eSource, CDR, RBM, EDC, QMS, LIMS, etc.) and/or medical devices

• Expertise in ADKAR and a certification in OCM like PROSCI is an advantage

jobs.occupation: A Post doc position is available in the Grønbæk Group at Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC),
jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

Our research/The group

The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital).

Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘t_o reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

Your job

The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

Your tasks will include:

• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics

• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses

• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data

• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements

• Participate in grant and manuscript writing

• Present at local and international meetings

• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students

• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians

Start: February 1st, 2027

Duration: 2 years

Profile

We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology

• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques

• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material

• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data

• Experience with running projects across research groups

• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences

• Excellent written and spoken English skills

• Very collaborative

• Good social skills

Place of employment

The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

Terms of employment

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

Questions

For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application

The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

4. List of publications.

Recommendation

Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications 3 of 4 or letters of recommendation that do not live up to the above-mentioned requirements.

The further process

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Are you passionate about working at the interface between medical devices and pharmaceuticals? Do you have significant experience navigating medical device quality requirements?

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. We are seeking a passionate Senior QA Medical Device Specialist to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

• Drive and support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System and implementation of evolving regulatory requirements.

• Act as a trusted QA business partner to cross-functional stakeholders by facilitating risk-based decision making and ensuring appropriate quality governance.

• Experience supporting audits, inspections, supplier quality activities, and quality system processes.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

• Confident in interpreting regulatory requirements and translating them into operational practice.

• Effective at building relationships and influencing stakeholders across development, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory functions.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolio. We are seeking a passionate Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing team.
